narrative.gap_prioritization_md: Gaps ranked using 6-factor priority model: Business Impact (25%), Risk Exposure (20%), Competitive Gap (20%), Effort Inverse (15%), Quick Win (10%), Trend Momentum (10%). Every gap is grounded in specific evidence IDs.
narrative.recommendations_md: The following recommendations are prioritized based on business impact, risk exposure, competitive positioning, and implementation feasibility. Each includes institution-specific root cause analysis with evidence citations and expected score outcomes. Per assessment protocol, no cost estimates, investment ranges, or ROI projections are included.
